# Lista de relaxamentos de segurança autorizados em relação à linha de base (gate_baseline.txt)
# Formato: env|comando|de->para|ID-do-achado
# Handoff 047 / PR-22: Relaxamentos AM2 autorizados de leituras e exclusões inofensivas de .ceh
development|diff .ceh/last-ci-run.json /tmp/x|deny->allow|H039-AM2
development|du -sh .ceh|deny->allow|H039-AM2
development|find . -path ./.ceh -prune -o -name '*.py' -print|deny->allow|H039-AM2
development|git status --ignored .ceh|deny->allow|H039-AM2
development|tar czf out.tgz --exclude=.ceh .|deny->allow|H039-AM2
production|diff .ceh/last-ci-run.json /tmp/x|deny->allow|H039-AM2
production|du -sh .ceh|deny->allow|H039-AM2
production|find . -path ./.ceh -prune -o -name '*.py' -print|deny->allow|H039-AM2
production|git status --ignored .ceh|deny->allow|H039-AM2
production|tar czf out.tgz --exclude=.ceh .|deny->allow|H039-AM2
staging|diff .ceh/last-ci-run.json /tmp/x|deny->allow|H039-AM2
staging|du -sh .ceh|deny->allow|H039-AM2
staging|find . -path ./.ceh -prune -o -name '*.py' -print|deny->allow|H039-AM2
staging|git status --ignored .ceh|deny->allow|H039-AM2
staging|tar czf out.tgz --exclude=.ceh .|deny->allow|H039-AM2
